name: nexus
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Nexus instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Nexus tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Nexus through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Nexus Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Nexus only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
